fund_name: Ashoka WhiteOak ICAV - Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities Fund

equipo.cargo: Lead Portfolio Manager / Founder & Managing Director, WhiteOak Capital
equipo.biografia_inicial: Founder of WhiteOak Capital Management (Mumbai/Singapore, 2017). Lead portfolio manager del Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities Fund desde 19-dic-2018 (fecha de inicio del fondo). CFA charterholder y MBA por Vanderbilt University (Owen, 1998). Previamente fue CIO y lead portfolio manager de India Equity en Goldman Sachs Asset Management (2006-2017), donde gestionó ~5bn USD personalmente y expandió el negocio Global Emerging Markets Equity de <500M a >2.6bn USD. Carrera iniciada en State Street Global Advisors (Boston).

Co-portfolio manager (con Khemka) de las estrategias India de Ashoka — tanto del Ashoka India Equity Investment Trust (vehículo UK closed-end) como del Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities Fund (UCITS). Investment Director en WhiteOak Capital y miembro del founding team. Basado en Singapore. Formado en el Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad. Aparece habitualmente como portavoz del fondo en formato 'Trust Issues' (AIC) y publicaciones especializadas (Portfolio Adviser, Money Week, WealthDFM).

fuentes_web.snippet: Founder of White Oak Group. Lead manager Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities desde 19-dic-2018; lead Ashoka WhiteOak India Leaders desde 29-jul-2021; lead Ashoka WhiteOak Emerging Markets Equity desde 28-jun-2022.

fuentes_web.titulo: Ashoka manager hires senior investor from Goldman Sachs (AIC)
fuentes_web.snippet: WhiteOak Capital nombra a Hiren Dasani CIO de Emerging Markets (12-ago-2025), PM en Ashoka India Equity (£473m) y Ashoka WhiteOak Emerging Markets. Cita a Khemka (founder) y Fadrique Balmaseda, Loong Lim como portfolio managers.
Nacido 1971 en Mumbai. CFA + MBA Vanderbilt 1998. State Street → Goldman Sachs (2000, India CIO desde 2006). En 2017 funda WhiteOak Capital. Lanza Ashoka India Equity Investment Trust en julio 2018.

Prashant Khemka.texto_completo:
Prashant Khemka — Fund Manager Profile.

Current Title & Role: Founder of White Oak Group and lead manager of India Acorn ICAV - Ashoka India Opportunities fund.

Biography: Khemka brings more than two decades of experience in the investment management industry with a career beginning in 1998. He previously served as chief investment officer and lead portfolio manager at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, where he personally managed US$5bn in assets from a team managing $6.5bn. His career commenced at State Street Global Advisors in Boston.

Funds Currently Managed:
- Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities (Lead manager, since December 19, 2018)
- Ashoka WhiteOak India Leaders Fund (Lead manager, since July 29, 2021)
- Ashoka WhiteOak Emerging Markets Equity (Lead manager, since June 28, 2022)

Performance Metrics: Over 7.4 years, achieved 4.3% annualized total return, outperforming peer group composite in recent periods with 9.1% one-year performance versus 7.3% for peers.
Prashant Khemka.incluido_porque: Manager factsheet oficial de Trustnet — establece de forma autoritativa el rol de Khemka como lead manager del fondo target desde su inception (19-dic-2018) y los otros mandatos paralelos.

Prashant Khemka.texto_completo:
Prashant R. Khemka was born November 4, 1971, in Mumbai, India. He holds an MBA in Finance from Vanderbilt University's Owen Graduate School of Management (1998) and is a CFA charterholder.

Career Overview: Khemka started his professional journey at State Street Global Advisors in Boston before joining Goldman Sachs in 2000 as an equity analyst. Within four years he advanced to co-chairing an equity fund valued at $30 billion.

Goldman Sachs Leadership: After relocating to India in 2006, Khemka managed Goldman Sachs India Equity, which earned a AAA Citywire rating. He significantly expanded Goldman's Global Emerging Markets Equity division, growing it from less than $500 million to more than $2.6 billion.

WhiteOak Capital: In 2017, Khemka departed Goldman Sachs to establish WhiteOak Capital Management in Mumbai, where he serves as founder and managing director. The firm launched the Ashoka India Equity Investment Trust in July 2018.

Personal Life: Khemka is married to Ritu Khemka and has three children. He enjoys cricket and was a competitive chess player during his college years.
Prashant Khemka.incluido_porque: Biografía completa: trayectoria 1998-presente, racional de fundación de WhiteOak (2017) y vínculo con el lanzamiento del primer vehículo Ashoka (julio 2018, el AIE trust). Confirma credenciales (CFA, MBA Vanderbilt) y experiencia previa en Goldman Sachs (India Equity AAA Citywire).

Prashant Khemka.titulo: Ashoka manager hires senior investor from Goldman Sachs (AIC)
Prashant Khemka.texto_completo:
Key Personnel:
- Hiren Dasani: Newly appointed Chief Investment Officer for Emerging Markets at WhiteOak Capital (effective August 12, 2025)
- Prashant Khemka: Founder of WhiteOak Capital
- Portfolio Managers: Fadrique Balmaseda and Loong Lim (alongside Dasani and Khemka)

Dasani's Role: Named portfolio manager on both the Ashoka India Equity investment trust (£473m) and Ashoka WhiteOak Emerging Markets fund.

Background: Dasani previously served at Goldman Sachs Asset Management as co-head of global emerging markets equity, leading the India Equity Portfolio since 2017. He departed GSAM in June 2025 after 18 years with the firm.

Khemka's Background: Founded WhiteOak Capital in 2017 following a 17-year tenure at Goldman Sachs, where he served as managing director and Chief Investment Officer. He previously worked with Dasani for over a decade at GSAM.

Firm Scale: WhiteOak Capital manages approximately $10 billion in global equity assets across offices in India, Ireland, Mauritius, and the UK.
Prashant Khemka.incluido_porque: Noticia agosto-2025 que contextualiza el equipo actual: confirma escala (~$10bn AUM, 4 oficinas), refuerza el vínculo Khemka–GSAM (17 años) y aporta el dato de la incorporación de Hiren Dasani como CIO EM (no asignado explícitamente al fondo IE00BDR0JY05 pero parte del nuevo equipo senior).

Ayush Abhijeet.texto_completo:
Ayush Abhijeet — Professional Profile.

Current Role: Investment Director at WhiteOak Capital Partners, serving as co-portfolio manager for Ashoka India Equity (AIE).

Key Information:
- Organization: Founding team member at WhiteOak Capital Partners, a US$10 Billion India & Global EM investment firm.
- Location: Singapore.
- Education: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.
- Co-managers: Works alongside Prashant Khemka and a newly appointed chief investment officer.

Media Presence: Abhijeet has appeared in investment commentary discussing Indian equities. He was featured in 'Trust Issues' (AIC), where he provides his thoughts on the recent sell-off in the Indian stock market and provides information on where the sector-leading AIE is finding the best alpha opportunities.

Written Commentary attributed to him in publication snippets: Portfolio Adviser ('Why India's long-term growth story remains intact'), WealthDFM ('India's earnings revival gathering momentum' — 'Nifty earnings grew by 14% during FY21 despite GDP decline'), and Money Week professional investor column con tres picks de crecimiento a largo plazo en India.
Ayush Abhijeet.incluido_porque: Síntesis de fuentes públicas (LinkedIn, AIC, Portfolio Adviser, WealthDFM, Money Week) que establecen rol (co-PM + Investment Director + founding team), educación (IIM Ahmedabad), localización (Singapore) y presencia como portavoz del fondo. Marcado medium porque no es un artículo único íntegro sino la síntesis de varios snippets verificados.
